OC

2026 · Python · PaddleOCR · MCP

OCR MCPOCR MCP

给 agent 用的 OCR 工具服务OCR as an MCP service for agents

基于 PaddleOCR 的 MCP stdio server：文字、表格、手写、公式都能认，公式直接输出 LaTeX；输入支持本地路径和 HTTP(S) URL，pip install 之后就能接进 Claude Desktop。A PaddleOCR-backed MCP stdio server: text, tables, handwriting and formulas — with LaTeX output. Inputs can be local paths or HTTP(S) URLs, and one pip install plugs it into Claude Desktop.

技术栈Stack

  • Python
  • PaddleOCR
  • MCP

亮点Highlights

  1. 四个工具：文字、表格、手写、公式识别Four tools: text, table, handwriting and formula recognition

  2. 中英日韩多语言，默认中文Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean, Chinese by default

  3. 表格识别输出结构化文本Table recognition returns structured text

  4. pip install ocr-mcp，stdio 直接跑pip install ocr-mcp, then run over stdio
